name: Princess Danger
original_name: ぷりんせすでんじゃあ
source:
500 years ago the Victorian kingdom built by Victorian I upon defeating the Devil suddenly disappeared after a period of prosperity.

Ayumi is the direct descendant and 42th ruler of the Victorian royal family. With the help of her companion Puchi she starts reconstruction of the Victorian kingdom.

It is said that waking up a great spirit and defeating a new devil is needed for resurrection. God have mercy on any poor souls who stand in Ayumi's way!

[edited from [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/07/vn-of-month-april-1994.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
500年前，维多利亚一世击败魔王，建立了维多利亚王国。王国繁荣一时后，却突然消失得无影无踪。

亚由美是维多利亚王室的直系后裔，也是第42代统治者。她在伙伴波奇的协助下，开始重建维多利亚王国。

传说若想让王国复兴，就必须唤醒大精灵，并击败新的魔王。愿神怜悯所有胆敢挡在亚由美面前的可怜人！

[根据[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/07/vn-of-month-april-1994.html]vndbreview[/url]修改]
